## Wave 1 Summary

The substrate IS a resonator. Its missing pieces are not new degrees of freedom — they are the post-freeze *processing* of an already-frozen relic spectrum, and the *threshold conditions* that decide how the supersonic transit couples to the substrate's own normal modes. This wave translates five tesla-survey findings into computes: (1) the post-fold GGE turbulent-cascade exponent E(k) from the Bogoliubov amplitudes — the substrate-physics tilt input TRANSIT-PS-67 has been missing since S67, and the freeze-vs-cascade timing comparison decides whether the relic is processed (U3 false) or diabatically frozen (U3 holds, R_therm=5251.82) [INV10-W1-1, tesla B1/G2/U3]; (2) the substrate roton (Δ_rot, p₀, μ_r) from the B3/optical dispersion and the Landau critical velocity v_c=Δ_rot/p₀ — deciding whether the Mach-13.75 transit is dissipative (roton/Leggett emission, a 2nd DM channel) or dissipationless (coherent horizon), adjudicating C1 [INV10-W1-2, tesla B3/R1]; (3) the second-sound CMB horizon ℓ=π·(c_fabric/c_Gold)≈721, dropped from every live register, re-derived with current four-speed values against Planck TT — the CMB-side companion to the banked first-sound BAO ring (Row #72) [INV10-W1-3, tesla B4/G4/R4]; (4) the Zak/Berry-phase winding across the fold in synthetic (τ) dimension — could make τ_fold=0.190 a topological invariant rather than an empirical input, using the global-winding machinery W5 (local Berry curvature Ω=0) was thought to have closed [INV10-W1-4, tesla B5/U1]; (5) the reconciliation of the three coexisting analog temperatures (T_acoustic=0.112 GGE-relic vs BLV surface-gravity vs Hawking-analog T_H=ħκ/2π) — a direct internal-consistency test of the acoustic-white-hole claim [INV10-W1-5, tesla R2]. # ---- Identity ----

```yaml
# ---- Verdict rubric ----
PASS_meaning: "A clean inertial-range power law E(k) ∝ k^{−p} is resolved (R² ≥ 0.90 over ≥ 1 decade) with p_substrate reported + classified vs {5/3, 1}, AND R_FC = t_freeze/t_cascade < 1 (the diabatic freeze suppresses the cascade). Solution space: the substrate now HAS a first-principles primordial-tilt input for TRANSIT-PS-67; the frozen-GGE-as-final assumption (U3) is corroborated by the timing; the long-open hole (TRANSIT-PS missing its substrate-physics tilt since S67) is filled."
FAIL_meaning: "Either no clean inertial range exists (the |β_k|² spectrum has no power-law window — the cascade picture does not apply to the substrate relic), OR R_FC ≥ 1 (the cascade onset precedes freeze-out ⇒ the relic IS turbulently processed ⇒ U3 is FALSE and the frozen-spectrum-as-CMB assumption breaks). Both are informative: the first closes the turbulent-cascade route to the tilt; the second re-opens the post-freeze-relaxation question for the whole cosmological arm."
INFO_meaning: "A power law is resolved but with R_FC ~ O(1) (marginal freeze-vs-cascade), OR p_substrate matches neither {5/3, 1} cleanly (a substrate-specific exponent). The tilt input exists but the freeze-vs-cascade verdict is undecided at this resolution — flags a deeper t_cascade computation as the forward gate."

  estimated_time: "0.5–1 day (reuses n_Bog / Parker-pair machinery; the new work is the per-shell E(k) assembly + inertial-range fit + timing comparison)"
```

## §W1-2. INV10-W1-2

```yaml
# ---- Identity ----
gate_id: "INV10-W1-2-ROTON-LANDAU-VC"
schema_version: "R3"
gate_type: "compute"
trigger: "[SIGN]"
classification: "PHONONIC"
agent_type: "tesla-resonance"
hypothesis: "The substrate's B3/optical dispersion ε(p) has a roton-like local minimum (Δ_rot, p₀, effective mass μ_r) — the Leggett mode IS the substrate roton (S58) — and the Landau critical velocity v_c = Δ_rot/p₀ sets the threshold for dissipationless transit; the Mach-13.75 transit velocity v_transit = 13.75·c_fabric is then compared to v_c to decide whether the transit emits rotons (dissipative, a 2nd DM-production channel) or flows coherently (dissipationless horizon)."

method:
  description: >
    (A) Load the B3/optical-branch dispersion ε(p) from `s62_phonon_dispersion_full` (.npz on disk; the
    full phonon dispersion including the optical branch; imports E_B3_mean=0.9782238787713764). Cross-check
    the gap against the canonical un-doubled B3 gap Delta_B3_s53=0.084152 M_KK (Fock multiplicity 3) and
    the doubled-gap convention Delta_B3=2·Delta_B3_s53=0.176 (S38). (B) Locate the roton minimum: the
    momentum p₀ at which ε(p) is locally minimal on the optical branch, the gap Δ_rot = ε(p₀), and the
    effective mass μ_r = [d²ε/dp²|_{p₀}]^{-1} (the curvature at the minimum). If the optical branch is
    purely gapped-monotone (no local minimum interior to the zone — plausible since SU(3) has no
    Brillouin-zone boundary, cross-ref qa B-QA-2), report Δ_rot as the band-edge gap and p₀ as the
    minimum-locating momentum, and flag the "degenerate roton" (flat-band) reading. (C) Compute the Landau
    critical velocity v_c = min_p [ε(p)/p] (the full Landau criterion, evaluated over the optical branch),
    and separately the roton-form value Δ_rot/p₀. (D) Compare v_transit = Mach_max_framework · c_fabric
    = 13.75 · 209.97368021 = 2887.14 M_KK against v_c. Landau 1941 (v_c = min ε(p)/p) and the He-II roton
    (measured ~60 m/s) are METHODOLOGICAL anchors for the criterion FORM, NOT canonical value sources.
  producing_script: "computations/investigation-10/inv10_w1_roton_landau_vc.py"

# ---- PRDR Checklist (8 items) ----

operator:
  type: "inequality"
  form: "verdict = sign(v_transit − v_c) where v_c = min_p[ε(p)/p] over the B3/optical branch; v_transit = Mach_max_framework·c_fabric"

strict_PASS_boundary:
  value: "0  # the dissipation verdict is decided by the SIGN of (v_transit − v_c). This is a two-branch/characterization gate: PASS = the roton parameters (Δ_rot, p₀, μ_r) are cleanly extracted AND v_c is computed AND the dissipation verdict is rendered; the physics branch (dissipative vs dissipationless) is the OUTPUT, not a pre-set target."
  direction: ">"

boundary_reachable_analytically:
  bool: false
  proof_ref: "null — v_c = min_p[ε(p)/p] is a numerical minimization over the tabulated optical dispersion; the comparison v_transit vs v_c is exact once both are computed. No pre-set analytic threshold (the gate's purpose is to FIND which side of v_c the transit sits on)."

reachable_rationals:
  includes_integer_mesh: false
  mesh_density: "continuous — ε(p), p₀, v_c are real-valued; the Mach number 13.75 and c_fabric are fixed canonical scalars"

machinery_pin_map:
  N_eval: "number of p-grid points on the B3/optical dispersion from s62_phonon_dispersion_full.npz (the script reads the cached grid resolution)"
  L_max: "10  # the s62 dispersion is computed on the L_max=10 D_K cache"
  scan_range: "the full optical-branch p-window from s62_phonon_dispersion_full.npz (the script pins [p_min, p_max] from the cache)"
  step_size: "the s62 cache p-spacing; minimization refined by parabolic interpolation near p₀ (adaptive)"
  tolerance: "1e-9  # float64 (local); the min-finder convergence tol 1e-10 (local)"
  scheme: "FW"
  convention: "ABSOLUTE  # ε(p) in M_KK units, no rescaling; v_c and v_transit both in M_KK"
  random_seed: "N/A — deterministic (dispersion is a fixed table; min-finding is deterministic)"
  GPU_path: "numpy.linalg — 1D dispersion vector + scalar minimization, no matrix ≥100×100. OMP_NUM_THREADS=8 cap before import numpy."

audit_discriminators:
  audit_sha256_inputs: ["script", "canonical", "pinmap"]
  content_sha256_inputs: ["script"]

substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim: "The Mach-13.75 transit is DISSIPATIVE (emits rotons/Leggett quasiparticles) iff v_transit > v_c."
    Step 1: v_transit := Mach_max_framework · c_fabric   [the transit velocity = Mach number × sound speed, by definition of Mach]
    Step 2: Mach_max_framework = 13.75   [canonical, S85; v_transit/c_fabric at the van Hove fold]
    Step 3: c_fabric = 209.97368021 M_KK   [substrate sound speed, S42]
    Step 4: v_transit = 13.75 · 209.97368021 = 2887.14 M_KK   [substitute Steps 2,3]
```
